description: This PHP class 'LeaveEntitlementDecorator' provides a decorator pattern implementation for the LeaveEntitlement entity in the OrangeHRM system, adding methods for managing leave entitlement data, formatting dates, and checking deletability.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the LeaveEntitlement entity, providing additional methods for managing leave entitlement data, date formatting, and business logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveEntitlement object.

methods.name: getAvailableDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of available leave days after subtracting used days.

methods.name: withinPeriod
methods.description: Checks if a given date falls within the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setEntitlementTypeById
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type based on its ID.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an employee with the entitlement based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the leave type based on its ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted credited date, if available.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Determines if the leave entitlement can be deleted.
